descriptionMarkdown:
This is NORAD II. 

An **INEFFICIENT** spaceship capable of going to Aquilo & back consistently. Requires Vulcanus & Fulgora tech. When I created this, I had physical, laser & explosive damage lvl12 researched so the guns are tailored to that. 

The planetary science packs are imported but up to the white science, all are produced on the ship. The epic buildings are only necessary if you want to produce science on the ship.

The collectors has to be at least rare tho. Can't keep up otherwise.

Has ample space to put your own designs on it.

Requires nuclear input from Nauvis & has optional water barrel refill from planet if your water falls below reserves to give it a headstart.

Takes about an hour to get ready for travel I think.

This is my first blueprint. I did not really care much about efficiency. I like to play chill. Regardless, let me know of any feedback :)
title: NORAD II - Inefficient Aquilo Travel
